column3: “Daniel” follows the reading tradition; the written form is “Danel.” “Hold dark” is rendered “a match for.”
“One who seals an example” is rendered “the seal of perfection”; the meaning is uncertain.
The names of the stones are uncertain; NASB has “ruby, topaz, diamond … beryl.”
“Cherub of expansion” is rendered “the anointed cherub”; the word is uncertain. The LXX reads “with the cherub.”
“People filled your middle” is rendered “You were internally filled,” and “I profaned you” as “cast you as profane.”
“Terrors you became” is rendered “You have become terrified.”
